title: Scoping and Setting the Terms
description: What a client asks for versus what they actually need, how to sample a real site without testing every page, and why the test environment matrix has to be decided and written down before you open a screen reader.

title: Running the Test Pass
description: The full test pass in the order that actually catches things: automated scan first for triage, then a systematic keyboard pass, then a real assistive-technology pass, then the cognitive-load and content review nothing automated can run.

title: Evidence, Judgment, and the Report
description: Writing a finding a developer can reproduce without a follow-up meeting, rating severity by user impact instead of ease of fix, telling a false positive from a real one, retesting without missing a regression, and delivering a full audit report.
